يحتوشون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَوِشُونَ (yaḥtawišūna) /jaħ.ta.wi.ʃuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# يُحْتَوَشُونَ (yuḥtawašūna) /juħ.ta.wa.ʃuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
